newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London gain after U.S. PPI data drops.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London gain after U.S. PPI data drops.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London gained on Friday after weaker-than-expected U.S. May producer prices increased hopes that a near-term hike in U.S. interest rates would be avoided, dealers said.
The Hong Kong London Reference Index rose 102.60 points to close 14,215.15, having opened cautiously with shares remaining around their Hong Kong closing levels.

But U.S. PPI data at 1330 GMT showed an unexpected fall to 0.3 percent in May compared with economists' forecasts of a 0.1 percent rise and market-makers reacted to the figures by marking Hong Kong stocks higher.
Dealers said turover was low, with investors unwilling to open new positions ahead of the weekend.
Shares to advance on their Hong Kong closes included banking group HSBC Holdings, which climbed 62.5 cents to HK$230.62-1/2.
Earlier, stocks in Hong Kong spent a volatile session, with the Hang Seng index closing up 188.21 points at 14,112.55.
-- Andrew Langlands, London Newsroom +44 171 542 3496 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
